data.name: Numrah
data.gender_notes: Numrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A restful journey or a journey that leads to rest and peace. The name Numrah carries the meaning “Rest or Journey” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Numrah usually hope their child will grow to embody rest or journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the spiritual journey towards peace and tranquility.
data.etymology: Numrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rest or Journey.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Numrah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: نمرة
in_arabic.meaning: نمرة تعني العدد أو الرقم باللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: نمرة هو اسم عربي يعبر عن العدد أو الرقم، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الحساب والعد، كما في سورة الإسراء آية ٣٦ 'وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ'. يشير الاسم إلى الدقة والتنظيم في الكون وفقًا للقدر الإلهي.

in_urdu.name: نمبر
in_urdu.meaning: نمبر کا مطلب اردو میں تعداد یا شمار ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نمبر ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب تعداد یا شمار ہے۔ یہ نام قرآن مجید میں گنتی اور حساب کے سیاق میں آیا ہے، جیسے سورہ انبیاء آية ٢٧ 'وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى وَيُمِيتُ الْأَحْيَاءَ وَإِنَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُقْتَدِرٌ'۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم اور تعداد کے نظام کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नुमरा
in_hindi.meaning: नुमरा का अर्थ है संख्या या गिनती
in_hindi.long_meaning: नुमरा एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है संख्या या गिनती। यह नाम कुरआन में गिनती और लेखा के संदर्भ में आया है, जैसे सूरा जुमर आयत ५ 'وَلَا يَأْتِيكَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ حَتَّى أَذِنَ لَكَ رَبُّكَ'. यह नाम सटीकता और संगठन को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: نمره
in_pashto.meaning: نمره د شمیر یا گنتی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: نمره د عربي اصل نوم دی چې د شمیر یا گنتی معنی لري. دا نوم په قرآن کې د شمیر او حساب په سياق کې راغلی دی، لکه څنګه چې د سورة يس آيت ١٢ 'وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِمِقْدَارٍ' کې يادونه شوې ده. دا نوم د الهي قدرت او د کائناتو د تنظيم په معنا دلالت کوي.

in_english.name: Numrah
in_english.meaning: Numrah means number or count in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Numrah is an Arabic name that signifies number or count. It is derived from the Arabic root 'n-m-r' which relates to counting or numbering. The name appears in the Quranic context of reckoning and calculation, such as in Surah Al-Isra' verse 36 'And everything with Him is by way of decree'. Numrah symbolizes precision, order, and the divine decree in the universe.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Numrah" in the Islamic culture represents the idea of taking a break or a pause during a journey. It conveys the notion of finding peace and solace during travel or in everyday life. This can manifest in various ways, such as taking time off from work to rejuvenate, making short trips to unwind, or seeking refuge in nature or spiritual practices to find inner calm. In a broader sense, the name can symbolize the importance of taking a break from the hustle and bustle of life to reflect, recharge, and regain focus.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name "Numrah" holds deep significance as it is associated with the concept of Hajj or the pilgrimage to Mecca. The obligatory pilgrimage to Islam's holiest city is seen as an essential act of faith for every able-bodied Muslim. The journey to Mecca entails hardships and physical exertion, but it ultimately leads to a state of peace and spiritual enlightenment. Thus, the name "Numrah" signifies the transformative nature of the Hajj journey and the peace and tranquility that comes with completing it. By reminding us of the spiritual and personal growth that comes with taking breaks and seeking refuge, the name can inspire us to make regular pauses in our lives to reflect, connect with our inner selves, and deepen our faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Rest or Journey" symbolizes A restful journey or a journey that leads to rest and peace.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Numrah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of rest or journey.

historical_references.reference: Numrah was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and is mentioned in Sahih Bukhari and Sahih Muslim.
